description: Ministry of Health - Food Control Administration Unit - The Food (Additives-General) Regulations 2019, w.e.f. 01.01.2020
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980, establishing legal requirements for food additives, including import/manufacture restrictions, labeling standards, and compliance with international standards (Codex Alimentarius). It creates a regulatory framework for food safety without involving government personnel changes or structural adjustments.
